newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed in livelier trading.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed in livelier trading.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mixed in livelier trade on Wednesday.
* Of six active issues three were down, two up and one flat.
* Volume soared to 25,556 shares from Tuesday's meagre 2,806, and so did turnover at 24.1 million kuna from 700,000 kuna.
* Biggest loser was drug firm Pliva which closed at 12,700 kuna, 600 kuna lower than the last week, following the downward trend in London.
* Biggest gainer was fully listed Zagrebacka Banka, recovering 20 kuna to close at 1,000, on the record volume of 22,688 shares.
* Other actively traded issue was hotelier Suncani Hvar which gained 10 kuna to close at 70, with 1,088 shares traded. ($1 = 5.3945 kuna)
